definitions.short: Kenaz , the name of an Edomite and of two Israelites
definitions.full: H7073. Qenaz קְנַז proper name, masculine in Edom , Κενεζ : son of Eliphaz Gen 36:11 = 1Chr 1:36 ; Gen 36:15 compare 36:42 = 1Chr 1:53 , and father of Othniel Josh 15:17 ; Judg 1:13 ; 3:9 , 11 (see Di Gn Bu RS 9.Comm. 1:13 GFM 1:13 ff. Mey Entstehung 115 f. ).
definitions.rootNote: probably from an unused root meaning to hunt; hunter ;
